say:1:1430209201:1.text: He'd never do that. He was allowed to become my servant after competing with many other candidates. This is an opportunity of a lifetime.
say:1:1430209201:1.source_cn: 反抗？这可是他们和多少人竞争之后争取到的机会！
say:1:1430209201:1.male: He'd never do that. He was allowed to become my servant after competing with many other candidates. This is an opportunity of a lifetime.
say:1:1430209201:1.female: He'd never do that. He was allowed to become my servant after competing with many other candidates. This is an opportunity of a lifetime.

say:2:1430209202:1.text: If they have no benefactor, they can only continue to struggle outside the royal city, fighting over for the Divine Dew like dogs over a scrap of meat.
say:2:1430209202:1.source_cn: 如果不依附我们，他们只能继续在王城外挣扎，争抢本就不够...
say:2:1430209202:1.male: If they have no benefactor, they can only continue to struggle outside the royal city, fighting over for the Divine Dew like dogs over a scrap of meat.
say:2:1430209202:1.female: If they have no benefactor, they can only continue to struggle outside the royal city, fighting over for the Divine Dew like dogs over a scrap of meat.

say:4:1430209203:1.text: I'll be obedient, my lady! I'll work hard!
say:4:1430209203:1.source_cn: 永远以主人的意志为准，我会努力工作的！
